messages.subject: Project Ember — COMPLETED — executed contract & transfer
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Confirming completion of Ashby House has taken place. We acknowledge receipt of the completion monies. The executed contract (attached) and dated transfer are released to you, together with the rent deposit deed and the title documents. Our client's undertaking re the Clydesford discharge stands; the DS1 will follow.

A pleasure working with you on this one.

Rachel Voss
Pendle Voss LLP
